claim_boundary: posthoc-registered causal method iteration on historically opened development and heldout scenes; a future unseen-scene confirmation remains required
question: Can a query-free surface hierarchy convert source-view evidence into object-scale support without scene-specific graph tuning, target RGB, target masks, or connected-component postselection?

motivation.compact_field_not_primary: Exact capability MPR and compact field have nearly identical NVOS/SPIn unary behavior; raw-MPR followed by the nonlinear adaptor collapses probability dynamic range by about 202 times.
motivation.local_graph_not_completion: Surface-safe propagation gives only a small SPIn Lego gain and does not improve the frozen NVOS unary macro; connected selection regresses strongly.

probability_preserving_completion_sentin.finding: Source completion can recover missing object support but entropy confidence cannot detect confident systematic errors; the two-scene candidate is rejected by its fern regression gate.

query_free_hierarchy.input: immutable typed surface-safe support graph bound to exact official DINO/SAM capability, local tangent relation, and available cryptographically bound covisibility
query_free_hierarchy.construction: deterministic maximum-spanning forest using descending affinity and canonical primitive-row edge identity as the exact tie-break
query_free_hierarchy.hierarchy: every successful Kruskal union creates one parent proposal over the union of its child leaf memberships; disconnected components remain separate roots

source_observation.field_base: current graph-free compact canonical field unary: SPIn K4 or NVOS K16 decoupled prototype/anchor
source_observation.direct_source_evidence: signed scribbles or a full reference mask remain the immutable source evidence; unobserved rows are never interpreted as negative

proposal_policy.candidate_domain: only ancestor chains of source-positive observed leaves in the fixed hierarchy; arbitrary graph cuts, edge thresholds, k grids, and target-selected proposals are forbidden
proposal_policy.multi_part_objects: deduplicated proposals from multiple positive branches are retained; a single connected component is never imposed
proposal_policy.selection: source-only out-of-fold responsibility-balanced Bernoulli log-loss, then responsibility-weighted AUC, then smaller support, then the field base on an exact tie
proposal_policy.multiple_comparison_control: the candidate family is exactly the predeclared ancestor chains and the final complexity tie-break is deterministic; no scene-specific candidate injection is allowed
proposal_policy.base_fail_safe: if the hierarchy arm does not strictly beat the field base under the frozen OOF rule, return the field base unchanged

probability_contract.hierarchy_probability: p_H is the bounded probability induced by the selected deduplicated hierarchy proposals; multi-branch combination must remain in [0,1] and be sealed in the implementation closure before target prediction

cross_validation.authority: one immutable source-evidence authority is sealed before any fold clearing and bound by every fold receipt
cross_validation.preferred_fold_unit: source-raster footprint blocks or complete hierarchy subtrees, never independent primitive rows when spatially adjacent rows share the same raster evidence
cross_validation.heldout_rule: clear every positive, negative, and raw prompt-evidence tensor for the complete heldout group before prototype, anchor, unary, hierarchy scoring, or fusion

required_before_benchmark_integration: unobserved rows do not become negative labels
unknown graph or source authority fails closed
implementation closure seals the exact p_H construction without target access

development.promotion: Both hierarchy selections must agree with their source-only OOF receipts; target IoU must improve the two-scene macro, and neither scene may regress more than 0.02. Otherwise stop before heldout.

heldout_after_development_only.opening_rule: Seal the complete source-only OOF decision and all candidate target score receipts before opening any target mask or metric.
heldout_after_development_only.promotion: Selected-action macro must be no lower than the always-base macro and no scene may regress more than 0.02.

expansion_after_heldout_only.spin9: remaining strict local9 scenes with unchanged implementation
expansion_after_heldout_only.nvos: remaining strict full8 scenes with unchanged implementation
